subtopics.label: Tumor Microenvironment and Cancer Immunity
subtopics.description: Research on the cellular and molecular composition of the tumor microenvironment, including tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, tumor-associated macrophages, cancer-associated fibroblasts, immune evasion mechanisms, and the interplay between immune cells and tumor cells that shapes cancer progression and therapy response.
subtopics.short_description: Cellular and molecular composition of the tumor microenvironment, including immune cell infiltration, evasion mechanisms, and therapy response.

subtopics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and Immune Checkpoint Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on immune checkpoint pathways (PD-1/PD-L1, CTLA-4, LAG-3, TIM-3, ICOS, VISTA, GITR), checkpoint inhibitor therapies, CAR T cell engineering, adoptive cell therapies, and combination immunotherapy strategies including radiation plus immunotherapy in preclinical and clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Immune checkpoint pathways, CAR T cell engineering, adoptive cell therapies, and combination immunotherapy strategies.

subtopics.label: Cancer Epigenetics and Chromatin Regulation
subtopics.description: Research on epigenetic mechanisms in cancer including DNA methylation, histone modifications, chromatin remodeling complexes (SWI/SNF, PRC1/2, EZH2), 3D chromatin architecture, and how epigenetic dysregulation drives tumor initiation, progression, and therapy resistance.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation, histone modifications, and chromatin remodeling complexes driving tumor initiation, progression, and therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Reprogramming
subtopics.description: Studies on metabolic alterations in cancer cells including lipid biosynthesis (FASN, ACC1, cholesterol), glucose metabolism, mitochondrial function, one-carbon metabolism, NAD+/NADPH pathways, and how metabolic reprogramming supports tumor growth, metastasis, and therapy resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Lipid biosynthesis, glucose metabolism, and mitochondrial function supporting tumor growth, metastasis, and therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Cancer Metastasis and Invasion Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular mechanisms driving cancer metastasis, including epithelial-mesenchymal transition, cancer cell invasion, organotropism, pre-metastatic niche formation, extracellular vesicle-mediated communication, and specific signaling pathways that promote metastatic dissemination.
subtopics.short_description: Epithelial-mesenchymal transition, organotropism, pre-metastatic niche formation, and signaling pathways driving metastatic dissemination.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genomics and Molecular Profiling
subtopics.description: Studies employing whole-genome, whole-exome, transcriptomic, and multi-omic sequencing to characterize somatic mutations, structural variants, copy number alterations, fusion genes, and molecular subtypes across cancer types, including computational methods for cancer driver discovery and tumor evolution.
subtopics.short_description: Whole-genome, transcriptomic, and multi-omic sequencing to characterize mutations, molecular subtypes, and tumor evolution.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Tumor Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research on circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), circulating tumor cells (CTCs), cell-free DNA methylation, and extracellular vesicle-based biomarkers for cancer detection, monitoring treatment response, tracking resistance mutations, and minimal residual disease assessment across cancer types.
subtopics.short_description: Circulating tumor DNA, CTCs, and extracellular vesicle biomarkers for cancer detection, treatment monitoring, and residual disease assessment.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation and Cancer Proliferation
subtopics.description: Research on cell cycle control mechanisms relevant to cancer, including CDK4/6 activity, Rb-E2F signaling, G1 checkpoint regulation, quiescence entry and exit, and how dysregulation of these pathways drives uncontrolled proliferation and informs CDK inhibitor therapy.
subtopics.short_description: CDK4/6 activity, Rb-E2F signaling, and checkpoint regulation driving uncontrolled proliferation and informing CDK inhibitor therapy.

subtopics.label: DNA Damage Response and Genomic Instability in Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies on DNA repair pathways (homologous recombination, NHEJ, base excision repair), replication stress, BRCA1/2 deficiency, chromosomal instability, and how defects in DNA damage response contribute to cancer mutagenesis, tumor evolution, and sensitivity to DNA-damaging therapies.
subtopics.short_description: DNA repair pathway defects, replication stress, and chromosomal instability contributing to mutagenesis and therapy sensitivity.

subtopics.label: Preclinical Cancer Models and Experimental Systems
subtopics.description: Development and application of preclinical cancer models including patient-derived xenografts, genetically engineered mouse models, organoids, cell lines, and in vivo systems used to study tumor biology, test therapeutic hypotheses, and recapitulate human cancer features.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived xenografts, engineered mouse models, organoids, and in vivo systems for studying tumor biology and testing therapeutics.

subtopics.label: Targeted Therapy Mechanisms and Drug Resistance
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of response and resistance to targeted cancer therapies including kinase inhibitors, CDK inhibitors, KRAS inhibitors, androgen receptor antagonists, and epigenetic drugs, encompassing both intrinsic and acquired resistance mechanisms and strategies to overcome them.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of response and resistance to kinase inhibitors, CDK inhibitors, and epigenetic drugs, with strategies to overcome them.

subtopics.label: Radiation Biology and Radiotherapy Combinations
subtopics.description: Studies on the biological effects of ionizing radiation on tumors and the immune system, including radiation-induced immunogenic cell death, neoantigen exposure, combination of radiotherapy with immunotherapy or targeted agents, and mechanisms of radiosensitivity and resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Biological effects of ionizing radiation on tumors and immunity, including combinations with immunotherapy and mechanisms of radiosensitivity.

subtopics.label: Lymphoma and Leukemia Molecular Biology
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular pathogenesis of hematologic malignancies including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, AML, MDS, and CLL, encompassing oncogenic drivers, epigenetic dysregulation, tumor microenvironment interactions, and mechanisms of transformation and clonal evolution.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular pathogenesis, oncogenic drivers, and clonal evolution in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, AML, MDS, and related hematologic malignancies.

subtopics.label: Nanoparticle Drug Delivery and Radioimmunotherapy
subtopics.description: Research on engineered nanoparticles, antibody-drug conjugates, pretargeted radioimmunotherapy, and novel drug delivery platforms designed to improve therapeutic index, tumor targeting, and efficacy of cancer treatments including radiopharmaceuticals and small molecule delivery systems.
subtopics.short_description: Engineered nanoparticles, antibody-drug conjugates, and radioimmunotherapy platforms designed to improve tumor targeting and therapeutic index.

subtopics.label: Oncogenic Signaling Pathways and Tumor Suppressor Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on key oncogenic and tumor suppressor signaling networks in cancer including PI3K/AKT/mTOR, RAS/MAPK, Wnt/β-catenin, Hippo, NF-κB, and androgen receptor pathways, and how their dysregulation drives malignant transformation and informs therapeutic targeting.
subtopics.short_description: PI3K/AKT/mTOR, RAS/MAPK, Wnt, and Hippo pathway dysregulation driving malignant transformation and informing therapeutic targeting.

subtopics.label: Thyroid Cancer Diagnosis and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on thyroid cancer subtypes including papillary, anaplastic, follicular, and medullary thyroid carcinoma, covering molecular diagnostics, cytopathology, radioiodine therapy, surgical outcomes, and prognostic factors.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular diagnostics, radioiodine therapy, and surgical outcomes across papillary, anaplastic, follicular, and medullary thyroid carcinoma.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Risk Factors and Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Studies examining breast cancer risk factors including reproductive history, genetic ancestry, polygenic risk scores, environmental exposures, biomarkers in benign breast tissue, and population-based cohort analyses.
subtopics.short_description: Reproductive history, polygenic risk scores, environmental exposures, and population-based analyses of breast cancer risk factors.

subtopics.label: Hematologic Malignancy Treatment and Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical studies of treatment strategies for acute and chronic leukemias, myelodysplastic syndromes, myeloproliferative neoplasms, and multiple myeloma, including novel agents, combination regimens, and survival outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Novel agents and combination regimens for leukemias, myelodysplastic syndromes, myeloproliferative neoplasms, and multiple myeloma.

subtopics.label: Genitourinary Cancer Therapy and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on bladder, renal cell, and prostate cancers including targeted therapies, immunotherapy combinations, biomarker-driven treatment selection, and outcomes analyses.
subtopics.short_description: Targeted therapies, immunotherapy combinations, and biomarker-driven treatment selection for bladder, renal cell, and prostate cancers.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Molecular Biology and Genomics
subtopics.description: Research on molecular subtypes, genomic alterations, tumor heterogeneity, and signaling pathways in prostate cancer, including studies of neuroendocrine differentiation, metabolomics, and clonal evolution.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular subtypes, genomic alterations, neuroendocrine differentiation, and clonal evolution in prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: Gastroesophageal and Colorectal Cancer Therapy
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and translational studies of systemic therapies for gastric, gastroesophageal junction, and colorectal cancers, including targeted agents, immunotherapy combinations, and biomarker analyses such as CLDN18.2 and HER2.
subtopics.short_description: Systemic therapies, immunotherapy combinations, and biomarker analyses for gastric, gastroesophageal junction, and colorectal cancers.

subtopics.label: Brain Tumors and Glioma Biology
subtopics.description: Research on glioblastoma, lower-grade gliomas, and pediatric brain tumors covering molecular classification, tumor microenvironment, therapeutic vulnerabilities, and treatment strategies including IDH inhibition and immunotherapy.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular classification, therapeutic vulnerabilities, and treatment strategies for glioblastoma, lower-grade gliomas, and pediatric brain tumors.

subtopics.label: Melanoma Biology and Immunotherapy
subtopics.description: Studies on melanoma molecular biology, immune responses, and clinical outcomes with checkpoint inhibitors and targeted therapies, including biomarker analyses, tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte characterization, and long-term survival data.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular biology, immune responses, and clinical outcomes with checkpoint inhibitors and targeted therapies in melanoma.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Computational Pathology in Cancer
subtopics.description: Development and application of machine learning, deep learning, and AI-based tools for cancer diagnosis, classification, prognosis prediction, and treatment response assessment using histopathological images, omics data, and clinical records.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and deep learning tools for cancer diagnosis, prognosis prediction, and treatment response assessment from histopathology and omics data.

subtopics.label: Cancer Imaging: MRI, PET, and Quantitative Methods
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of advanced imaging techniques including MRI-based tumor characterization, PET tracers, quantitative ultrasound, and multiparametric imaging for cancer diagnosis, treatment response monitoring, and theranostics.
subtopics.display_name: Advanced Imaging: MRI, PET & Quantitative Methods
subtopics.short_description: MRI-based tumor characterization, PET tracers, and multiparametric imaging for cancer diagnosis, treatment monitoring, and theranostics.

subtopics.label: Cancer-Associated Thrombosis, Stroke, and Cardiovascular Complications
subtopics.description: Research on thromboembolic and cardiovascular complications in cancer patients, including ischemic stroke mechanisms, arterial thromboembolism risk, cardiac tumors, cardiotoxicity, and anticoagulation strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Thromboembolic and cardiovascular complications in cancer patients, including stroke mechanisms, cardiotoxicity, and anticoagulation strategies.

subtopics.label: Small Molecule Drug Discovery and Target Identification in Cancer
subtopics.description: High-throughput screening, virtual screening, and medicinal chemistry efforts to identify and optimize small molecule inhibitors targeting cancer-relevant proteins including immune checkpoints, kinases, and protein-protein interactions.
subtopics.short_description: High-throughput screening and medicinal chemistry to identify and optimize inhibitors targeting kinases, checkpoints, and protein-protein interactions.

subtopics.label: Clonal Hematopoiesis, Genomic Evolution, and Cancer Risk
subtopics.description: Studies on clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential, somatic mosaicism, chromosomal alterations, and their associations with cancer risk, progression, and outcomes across hematologic and solid malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Somatic mosaicism, chromosomal alterations, and clonal hematopoiesis associations with cancer risk and progression across malignancy types.

subtopics.label: Tumor Biology: Microenvironment Crosstalk, Immune Evasion, and Progression Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Mechanistic studies of cancer progression involving tumor-stroma interactions, immune evasion strategies, metabolic reprogramming in the tumor microenvironment, and non-cell-autonomous mechanisms driving metastasis and therapy resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Mechanistic studies of tumor-stroma interactions, immune evasion, and metabolic reprogramming driving metastasis and therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Breast Cancer Molecular Subtypes and Targeted Therapy
subtopics.description: Research on molecular characterization, targeted therapy, and treatment outcomes in breast cancer subtypes including triple-negative, HER2-positive, and hormone receptor-positive disease, encompassing CDK4/6 inhibitors, antibody-drug conjugates, and resistance mechanisms.
subtopics.display_name: Breast Cancer Molecular Subtypes & Targeted Therapy
subtopics.short_description: Molecular characterization and targeted treatment of triple-negative, HER2-positive, and hormone receptor-positive breast cancer subtypes.
